closed_findings.finding: Food-only SAF duplicates globally blocked Tasks
closed_findings.closure: Original task/manifest duplicate gates remain global; Food duplicate listings reach FoodStore, while Kotlin child selects exact requested name and rejects multiple matches before returning URI. FoodStore rejects duplicate/ambiguous Food names independently.

closed_findings.finding: Food conflict copies could block Tasks or be ignored by Food
closed_findings.closure: isFoodConflictName recognizes only lowercase Food UUID prefix, contains Food extension and sync-conflict, excludes .jsonl suffix. Both tested conflict naming variants fail Food admission; TaskStore exempts only this new family and retains task/manifest/unclassified conflict rejection.

closed_findings.finding: Repeated linear target/ref checks made wide-group admission needlessly expensive
closed_findings.closure: FoodStore and projector precompute target sets, classify ref kind once, validate global refs before per-container replay; repeated per-container target checks removed. Existing malformed-reference validation remains in global admission.

authority_review: Distinct food-record hash domain and deterministic UUID-v5 module writer; .foodlog namespace leaves released task .jsonl records/hash domains untouched. Hashes establish integrity against retained heads, not household writer authentication.

Closed/canonical record decoder derives operation ID/order from envelope, rejects caller payload overrides and requires exact encoded bytes/hash; counters and signed64 string clock are bounded. Creation basis must match known unique container birth, target and earlier clock. Wrong-kind/cross-container/noncausal refs reject regardless target projection readiness. Missing refs and transitive dependencies remain explicit pending and are excluded from ready projection.

Actual bounded file/SAF reads enforce unknown/growing size limits; record256KiB, stream16MiB,total32MiB,streams256,records50k,containers100k. Protected receipt COUNT/SUM/MAX are checked before BLOB loads, per-row bytes before decoding;1000records/8MiB pending authority limits. Local regular-file checks reject static links; not a malicious same-account OS TOCTOU isolation guarantee.

Guard reservation plus exact raw receipt stage share one owning short SQL transaction before provider append. No provider I/O inside SQL txn. Readback checks admitted chain plus trusted heads, exact reserved prefix and incomplete-tail byte prefix; acknowledgement/receipt retirement/heads/location commit together before memory publication. Missing/truncated/changed admitted stream and reservation mismatches fail closed.

Schema3 adds Food tables after exact prior schema checks; released protected task/settings/import rows are not reconstructed. Shared profile queue, module location lease and close drain preserve owner exclusion/poison-safe release. Only derived Food state is replayed; protected authority survives.

Expected Food history/semantic/stream scan faults have FoodHistoryFailure; startup catches only that type after shared manifest/profile revalidation and independently rechecks Tasks. Shared profile/manifest/guard/receipt errors remain hard. Runtime hard Food refresh faults stop importer and gate host writes, while module history faults retain last valid Food view and Tasks availability. Final caveat: already waiting host actions currently lack a post-sync sharedSafetyError guard; this race holds final closure.
